title: Chapter 169 Gong Zheng Becomes A Military Commander
content:
Chapter 169 Gong Zheng Becomes A Military Commander

And these captive bandits can only be temporarily placed here.

Wang Shuo looked at the three generals, all of whom were severely injured and tied with ropes. Wang Shuo thought about it and was still a little worried.

He looked at his backpack and found four scrolls of "Thought Stamp".

He took the three leaders to a distance and asked them one by one whether they were willing to surrender.

The result surprised Wang Shuo. He was ready to give them a scroll, but the three of them refused to surrender.

Wang Shuo was not in the mood to waste time with them and executed them directly.

These people are all unstable factors of the bandits. If they cannot be controlled, it is better to completely eliminate them in the bud.

[Primary general job transfer scroll +3, soul crystal +10, bronze sword production blueprint +1. ]

In addition, there are hundreds of energy crystals.

Wang Shuo was not surprised to get three general job transfer scrolls, but was a little disappointed. All three of them were job transfer certificates for primary generals.

As for the Soul Crystal, this high-level general actually dropped 5 pieces, which surprised Wang Shuo.

Although Wang Shuo killed a gold boss Brunei, it is impossible to accurately judge what items he dropped.

Presumably, the high-level generals and the gold boss should be at the same level!

"Gong Zheng, come here. This general job transfer certificate is for you to use first."

Wang Shuo has no suitable candidate for the other two, so he can only put them aside and use them later.

Gong Zheng smiled: "Thank you, Lord."

Wang Shuo was very happy to see Gong Zheng's expression. The tool man originally had no expression. It seems that Gong Zheng's self-consciousness is also awakening.

[General job transfer certificate: After use, various basic attributes and defense power will be increased by 20% on the original basis. ]

Gong Zheng's strength has been greatly improved again. The later the stage, the stronger the strength that is improved by 100%.

Wang Shuo looked at his profession and smiled bitterly. He had to change his profession to a shield soldier to become a real iron man!

Wang Shuo took out the production drawings of the bronze sword and found that although it was still a fine equipment, its attributes were much higher than ordinary fine equipment, and it should be the attribute second only to gold equipment.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction. The Hundred-Step Piercing Bow he bought before was also a much stronger bow than ordinary fine equipment.

With these two weapons, Wang Shuo's confidence increased greatly.

Just when Wang Shuo was daydreaming, Ayub came back.

"How is it?"

"My Lord, the other side has 400 archers, forming a powerful long-range firepower network, and 100 infantrymen, who are trying to climb up the city wall at this time." Ayub said lightly.

Wang Shuo was delighted when he heard this. It turned out to be an archer.

Cavalry restrains archers. This really hits the muzzle of our gun. This time you will definitely pay the price.

"Haven't you been discovered?" Wang Shuo narrowed his eyes and smiled evilly.

"No." Ayub shook his head.

Wang Shuo called up the troops and left more than 20 people to guard the prisoners. The others all adjusted their status to the best state.

Then he followed Ayub and attacked from behind the enemy archers.

The distance of 5 miles was very short, and the enemy archers were soon seen.

This archer unit was constantly attacking the south gate.
